question: If CAMPUS is coded as DBNQVT, how is DBNQVT coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**For CAMPUS to DBNQVT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15fdec9020697120ef6bfe12d3d0bed4b96502259d4e71e16690d7d8bc7cc6d3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/011523ec201e123844533e087301084a87caf42214e803de50d231b4c250b06f.png] 

The logic is to add +1 to the positional value of each letter.

**Applying the same logic to DBNQVT:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de1d4bdeb016c769faacb29762710eb1dfdd51f0f6132eb36e9a4b98477024e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb1aac5e92875fb1b9a3b8fa37f68d11433137a203f02c89ba3caceb471a30e7.png] 

 

Thus, **DBNQVT** is coded as **ECORWU**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
